reviews.text:
Tony is an absolute expert when it comes to pools and pool equipment! His knowledge is incredibly deep, and he diagnosed my equipment issue quickly and accurately. What impressed me just as much as his expertise was his genuine honesty in his assessment of the problem. He didn't try to upsell or exaggerate the repair needed.
He provided a truly affordable quote, and the guidance I received was invaluable. If you're looking for someone who is both highly knowledgeable and genuinely trustworthy in the pool repair business, Tony is the person to call. He is a rare find!
reviews.author: Sharath Punreddy

reviews.text: After communicating with Tony for many months about replacing my 30 year old pool filter, I finally decided to have it replaced.Tony was responsive and we quickly agreed on a price (a fair one) and set up a date for installation. Tony arrived on time with a colleague and they did the replacement in short order.  I am completely satisfied with the Jandy product (which Tony recommended) and the professional installation.  I have used Aqua Medic for other repairs in the past and have recommended Tony many times.  I will continue to do so since he is honest and easy to deal with.
reviews.author: Bert Lacativo

reviews.text:
The salt cell broke on my pool equipment  at just under 2 years old.  I called Jandy and they confirmed it was still under warranty.

The first of 2 places they recommended  for warranty work was AcquaMedic. I cannot say enough about this company and not surprised why Jandy recommends them.

With more than 30 years prior experience servicing pools, there isn't too much they don't know. From the first phone call speaking with Nannette to the in person conversation when Tony came out to inspect the equipment,  I've learned so much about pool maintenance.  Tony was back in just a couple of days with new salt cell as well as transformer for the panel that was also broken.

Can't say enough about AcquaMedic. They are friendly,  knowledgeable and great at communicating throughout the process.  Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Donna A

reviews.text: This is the 2nd time we have used Aqua Medic for our pool equipment needs.  They are so helpful and reasonable every time.  They got us back up and rolling the next day and Tony and Nannette are such nice people.  We highly recommend them to anyone with pool issues!!
reviews.author: Colby Shannon

reviews.text: Tony was awesome! Super nice, quick and reliable. Got our pump working brand new and provided all the info we needed before he left. Thank you!
reviews.author: Megan Mosaddaque

reviews.text: Tony fixed things in our pool, while replacing the heater, that had been setup incorrectly for 9 years.  He is AWESOME!
reviews.author: Jude Plauche

reviews.text: I've been using Aqua Medic since 2015 to keep my pool equipment running.  Tony has proven himself to be honest and fair.  My pool is old and they've fixed what can be fixed and replaced what couldn't be repaired.  They help me save money when possible and don't try to upsell just to make money.
reviews.author: TJ Bailey

reviews.text: Tony did what other pool repair companies said they couldn’t do. Tony did an outstanding job automating my pool controls.
reviews.author: Tina Pollack
